verdict.line: You lose if you walk into free Infected Cleaver poke before level 6; you win if you all-in at 4 passive stacks behind Executioner's Calling.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo wants a long, low-stakes poke war where Infected Cleaver chips your max health for free while Adrenaline Rush and Sadism regenerate it back — he isn't trying to out-duel you, he's trying to out-sustain you. Irelia's Q-E all-in does more damage in three seconds than Mundo's passive can regen in thirty, which is why the 54.6% win rate over 141 games and the solo-kill edge both sit with you. The matchup is decided by whether you let him poke uncontested or force the fight on your terms.

theirWindow.when: his Q is up, no minion to body-block
theirWindow.what: Infected Cleaver is a 975-range skillshot on a 4s cooldown that scales off your max health, so it gets worse the more you stack HP items. Hold position behind minions or walk up at an angle so a wasted cleaver resets his 4s timer instead of landing clean.

yourWindow.when: E up, 4 passive stacks, Mundo inside 850 range
yourWindow.what: Bladesurge (Q) onto a minion or him to close the gap, then land Flawless Duet (E) for the stun and Mark. At 4 Ionian Fervor stacks your next hits carry bonus on-hit damage, and a Marked or killed target instantly refreshes Q's cooldown for a follow-up strike or clean disengage.

start.why: Sustains you through Mundo's early Infected Cleaver poke (85.6% pick, 56.8% win rate) while adding enough early AD to make Q-E trades hurt back.

boots.why: 61.7% win rate over 94 games; flattens the auto-attack chip damage Mundo adds on top of his ranged Q poke during extended trades.

core.why: Current-health damage shreds Mundo's stacked HP pool and the passive slow/heal lets you stick through a fight he's trying to regen out of.
Highest win-rate path (74.2% over 31 games) and scales with the side-lane/wave pressure you'll be applying once you're ahead.
Attack speed compounds Ionian Fervor stacking, and the magic resist blunts Burning Agony's residual drain damage.

situational.when: mundo's sustain is outpacing your trade damage
you need to survive extended skirmishes against his Masochism burst
you want straightforward single-target DPS over more on-hit scaling

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through the exact kind of extended, sustain-heavy fight Mundo forces, and its adaptive healing on takedown directly offsets his regen.

summoners.why: 90.5% pick rate at 56.1% win rate; Ignite's damage-over-time and Grievous Wounds directly answer Adrenaline Rush's passive regen and the burst heal from Sadism, matching OP.GG's own kill-pressure read on this matchup.

playing.title: Trade through minions, not face-to-face
playing.detail: Bladesurge (Q) can target minions at 600 range, so dash through the wave to close distance on Mundo without eating a free Infected Cleaver in the open.

playing.title: All-in at 4 passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor caps at 4 stacks and grants bonus on-hit damage there. Time engages for when you're already stacked from poking or last-hitting so the fight opens with max attack speed and damage.

playing.title: Expect his W to cut your stun short
playing.detail: Burning Agony reduces disable duration, so if Mundo turns it on during your E stun the lockdown shrinks. Land your follow-up damage immediately instead of waiting out a full stun.

playing.title: Rush Executioner's Calling if sustain wins
playing.detail: Per the measured data, Grievous Wounds is the direct counter to both Adrenaline Rush's constant regen and Sadism's regen burst — buy it the moment trades stop sticking.

playing.title: Dodge his low-HP Masochism window
playing.detail: Masochism gives Mundo AD scaling with missing health, so his damage spikes hardest when he's critically low. Don't extend a fight into that window expecting an easy finish.

playing.title: Chain Q off E's mark for follow-up
playing.detail: Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes instantly if the target is Marked by E or dies to it. Land E first, then use the reset Q to either finish the trade or dash away safely.

playing.title: Punish his R cooldown, not his autos
playing.detail: Sadism is on a 75s cooldown; once he's burned it for an escape or sustain burst, he has no answer to a second all-in until it's back up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the matchup.
